item.title: Frequent death of patients in emergency situations sparks concern among Nigerians
item.description: The recurring death of patients in emergency situations, allegedly due to hospital negligence has sparked widespread public concern across the country. In many healthcare facilities, critically ill patients reportedly face delays in receiving urgent medical attention, sometimes resulting in preventable fatalities. Families of victims are left devastated, while public confidence in health institutions continues to […] Frequent death of patients in emergency situations sparks concern among Nigeria

item.title: EPL: Didi Hamann names team to stop Arsenal from winning quadruple this season

item.title: Kwara council chairman summons emergency meeting over bandits alleged threat letter
item.description: Chairman of Oyun Local Government in Kwara State, Akanbi Kamar Olarewaju, on Friday, convened an emergency security meeting at the council’s secretariat in Ilemona following a widely circulated letter alleging an impending attack by armed bandits on parts of the local government area. item.title: El-Rufai denies involvement in Dadiyata’s abduction
item.description: Former Kaduna State Governor, Nasir El-Rufai, has denied knowledge of a Nigerian social media critic, Abubakar Idris, popularly known as Dadiyata. item.title: ‘Buhari ruled by intimidation, Tinubu cajoling everybody into one-party state’ — Bishop Onah
item.description: The Catholic Bishop of Nsukka Diocese, Godfrey Onah, has stated that Nigeria is gradually sliding into a one-party state. This is even as he accused the current administration of using financial inducements to weaken opposition parties.
